title: Intravenous Fluid Resuscitation Setup
author: U.S. Army photo by Spc. Enrique Moya
caption: Intravenous fluid bag and infusion tubing prepared for crystalloid volume resuscitation in trauma care.
alt_text: Close-up photograph of clear intravenous fluid infusion bag and drip chamber.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates crystalloid IV fluid resuscitation, which NASA CliFF-016 notes is the primary spaceflight volume replacement modality when blood products are unavailable (CLIFF-016, p.1, p.10).
